what: A known platform quirk cost a CI round. A Windows-only quirk (it refuses private files placed directly under the test runner's raw temp directory) was known but lived only in the coordinator's memory, not in any job prompt. A new job hit it again: one CI round (about 6 minutes) plus one fix job.
rule: Known platform gotchas travel with every build job in that repository.
fix: Enforcement: a per-root `.swarm/gotchas.md` (a linked worktree falls back to its main worktree's file, like the toolchain env file) is appended to every claude, codex and shell job prompt and to `env --print`; `validate` warns `windows-ci-no-gotchas` when the repository's CI runs on Windows and no gotchas file exists. Regression coverage is in `tests/field-lessons-batch-f.test.mjs`.
